newsitem.title: USA: Tenet says resolves OrNda investigation.
newsitem.headline: Tenet says resolves OrNda investigation.

text.p: Tenet Healthcare Corp said Thursday it had reached an agreement resolving an investigation of OrNda HealthCorp initiated by the Justice Department before Tenet acquired OrNda in January.
Under the agreement, OrNda has paid about $12.6 million to settle the whistle-blower suit filed under the False Claims Act, it said.
The settlement covers financial relationships between hospitals acquired by OrNda in a merger with Summit Health Ltd in April 1994 and certain doctors at the hospitals, Tenet said in a news release.
The government had alleged that certain financial relationships with physicians were created in return for the referral of patients to certain OrNda hospitals, in violation of federal law, it said.
Tenet was not accused of any wrongdoing and was the settling party only because it had acquired OrNda, Tenet said.

The Department of Health and Human Services has decided not to impose any increased corporate integrity requirements on the former OrNda hospitals because they are now operating under Tenet's compliance program. The hospitals will continue to participate in the federal insurance program, Tenet said.
